name: xbert-reconcile
description: Reconcile bank lines against ledger entries using XBert matching.

x-xbert.tagline: Auto-match bank lines to ledger entries with explanations you can audit.
prerequisites: Connected bank feed (any major Australian or NZ bank)
x-xbert.longDescription:
Bank reconciliation eats more time in a practice than any other single workflow. Most lines match obviously; a few are tricky; the long tail of one-offs swallows hours. Existing rules-based engines either auto-apply too aggressively and quietly corrupt the ledger, or bury you in noise.

XBert Bank Reconciliation matches with reasoning. It pulls unmatched lines, proposes the most likely ledger match — exact, date-shifted, split, or contra — and shows the calibrated confidence so you batch-approve the obvious matches and focus on the genuinely unclear ones. Nothing is applied without your say-so, and every approval is logged.

useCases.title: Daily ops reconciliation
useCases.description: Run at the end of each day across a small business's main operating account to keep the ledger trued up.

useCases.title: Merchant settlements
useCases.description: Handles Stripe, Square, and PayPal settlements where processor fees hide between gross sales and net deposits.

useCases.title: Inter-account transfers
useCases.description: Matches transfers between accounts without ever double-counting them as income or expense.

useCases.title: Catch-up reconciliation
useCases.description: Works through a long backlog of unmatched lines after a bank feed broke or a client fell behind.

benefits.title: Batch the easy 80%
benefits.description: High-confidence exact matches get bulk-approved in one click. The grind drops away. You only think about the tricky lines.

benefits.title: See the reasoning every time
benefits.description: Every match comes with its evidence — "amount $123.45 + reference INV-001". No black box. Full audit defence if the ATO asks.

benefits.title: Spot the splits humans miss
benefits.description: Multi-line allocations, contra entries and settlement nets are flagged for you to review instead of being silently misclassified.

workflow: Confirm the bank account and date range
Plugin pulls unmatched lines and proposes matches with a calibrated confidence score
Batch-approve >95% confidence in one click; walk through the rest one at a time
Full audit log of every match auto-saved with each approver and timestamp
